Übernimm die vollständige Verantwortung für den Erfolg, die Entwicklung und das Wachstum deines Kundenportfolios und stelle sicher, dass kein Detail verloren geht und jede Zusammenarbeit außergewöhnlichen Mehrwert schafft. Erkenne Kundenbedürfnisse, geschäftliche Herausforderungen und neue Chancen, bevor sie von deinen Kunden selbst identifiziert werden. Berate CEOs, Gründer:innen, CMOs und weitere Führungskräfte souverän zu Themen wie Unternehmensstrategie, Markenentwicklung, kultureller Relevanz, Innovation, Partnerschaften und Wachstum. Führe strategische Gespräche, moderiere Workshops und begleite komplexe Stakeholder-Prozesse mit Klarheit, Souveränität und Überzeugungskraft. Strategische Beratung Entwickle strategische Narrative, Positionierungen, kulturelle Plattformen und Wachstumsstrategien mit nachhaltiger Wirkung. Übersetze komplexe unternehmerische Herausforderungen in klare strategische Empfehlungen und umsetzbare Lösungen. Erarbeite Strategien, schärfe Botschaften, optimiere Präsentationen und hinterfrage Denkansätze, um jede Arbeit auf das nächste Niveau zu heben. Arbeite eng mit den STAN Foundern sowie den Teams aus New Business, Strategy, Creative, Production, Social und AI zusammen, um strategisches Denken in außergewöhnliche Umsetzung zu übersetzen. Verbinde Ideen, Branchen und Chancen auf unerwartete Weise und schaffe dadurch strategische Wettbewerbsvorteile für unsere Kunden. Kundenerfolg & Qualität Übernimm die Gesamtverantwortung für die Kundenbeziehung – von der strategischen Ausrichtung bis zur finalen Umsetzung. Fungiere als Qualitätsinstanz für sämtliche Kundenprojekte und stelle sicher, dass jede Arbeit den kreativen Ansprüchen von STAN entspricht. Hinterfrage Ideen kontinuierlich, schärfe Ergebnisse und hebe gemeinsam mit den Teams das strategische und kreative Niveau. Sorge dafür, dass Projekte mit höchster Qualität, Konsistenz und Liebe zum Detail umgesetzt werden. Wachstum & Geschäftsentwicklung Erkenne Potenziale, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen durch neue Projekte, strategische Partnerschaften und langfristige Retainer auszubauen. Entwickle Angebote, Leistungsumfänge und strategische Empfehlungen, die sowohl für unsere Kunden als auch für STAN nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen. Baue vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, aus denen langfristige Partnerschaften, Folgeprojekte und Weiterempfehlungen entstehen. Beziehungsentwicklung Entwickle langfristige Partnerschaften, die auf Vertrauen, Glaubwürdigkeit und exzellentem Service basieren. Erkenne Potenziale, bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiterzuentwickeln und nachhaltige Kooperationen aufzubauen. Werde durch proaktives Denken, Verlässlichkeit und strategische Führung zu einem geschätzten Teil der Teams unserer Kunden. Repräsentiere STAN souverän in Kundenterminen, Workshops, internationalen Präsentationen und Branchenevents. Leadership Führe interdisziplinäre Teams mit Empathie, Klarheit und hohen Qualitätsansprüchen. Inspiriere und fördere Kolleg:innen und schaffe ein Umfeld, in dem außergewöhnliche Arbeit entstehen kann. Übernimm Verantwortung statt lediglich zu koordinieren – indem du mit gutem Beispiel vorangehst und selbst aktiv zu strategischen und kreativen Ergebnissen beiträgst. DEIN PROFIL Strategische Führungspersönlichkeit Mindestens 6-8 Jahre Berufserfahrung in einer führenden Kreativagentur, Markenberatung oder Strategieberatung. Umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Führung internationaler Kunden sowie komplexer Stakeholder-Strukturen. Fundiertes Verständnis von Unternehmensstrategie, Markenentwicklung, Cultural Strategy, Innovation, Experience Design und integrierter Kommunikation. Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, strategische Empfehlungen zu entwickeln und überzeugend vor Führungskräften und Entscheidungsträgern zu präsentieren. Hands-on-Berater:in Du koordinierst nicht nur Spezialisten, sondern arbeitest selbst aktiv an den Inhalten mit. Du entwickelst Strategien, optimierst Präsentationen, moderierst Workshops, schärfst Botschaften und hinterfragst Denkansätze. Du verbindest strategische Exzellenz mit unternehmerischem Verständnis und einer außergewöhnlich hohen Umsetzungsqualität. Du erkennst Chancen frühzeitig, löst Probleme proaktiv und bringst Projekte mit Eigeninitiative voran. Beziehungsmanager:in Du baust Vertrauen auf, bevor es um Geschäft geht. Du entwickelst langfristige Partnerschaften, anstatt Projekte lediglich zu verwalten. Du verstehst es, Kunden zu inspirieren, herauszufordern und zu überzeugen, ohne tragfähige Beziehungen zu gefährden. Du überzeugst durch Souveränität, Präsenz und ein sicheres Urteilsvermögen auf Executive-Ebene. Unternehmerisches Denken Du erkennst Potenziale, Kundenbeziehungen durch strategisches Denken und vertrauensvolle Partnerschaften nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Du fühlst dich sicher im Umgang mit Angeboten, Leistungsumfängen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeitsmodellen. Du verstehst, wie exzellente Kundenführung nachhaltiges Unternehmenswachstum ermöglicht. Qualitätsanspruch Du verfügst über ein außergewöhnliches Gespür für Qualität und höchste Ansprüche an jedes Detail. Du hebst die Qualität jeder Arbeit und inspirierst dein Umfeld dazu, denselben Anspruch zu verfolgen. Dir sind kreative Exzellenz und messbarer geschäftlicher Erfolg gleichermaßen wichtig. Persönliche Eigenschaften Neugierig, unternehmerisch denkend und von Natur aus proaktiv. Ruhig und souverän – auch in dynamischen oder unklaren Situationen. Begeistert für Kultur, Kreativität, KI, Innovation und die Zukunft von Marken und Unternehmen. Hervorragende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (nahezu muttersprachliches Niveau) sind Voraussetzung. Weitere Sprachkenntnisse wie Deutsch, Französisch oder Arabisch sind von Vorteil. Erfahrung oder Interesse im Bereich Women's Health ist von Vorteil. Verfügbarkeit Wohnsitz in den USA, idealerweise in New York oder Los Angeles. For more information, visit&nbsp;<u><a href="http://wpp.com/" data-outlook-id="2714312b-312f-4651-9f88-d8a4e47547bc">WPP.com</a></u>.</p></div><h4>Your role in a nutshell</h4> <p>In this role you will be solely responsible for working on design briefs for our client's Australian presence. title: Forward Deployed Engineer - EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.</p> <p>The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values&nbsp;and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. <a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OuZIb5zszQI">Co-create the future with us</a> as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.</p> <p>*<em>Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.</em></p></div><h2><strong>Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, Agentic SDLC - (EMEA Only)</strong><strong><br></strong><strong><br></strong><strong>An overview of this role</strong></h2> <p>GitLab’s Forward Deployed Engineering team is a field-situated product engineering function focused on strategic customer outcomes, artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, and direct contributions to GitLab’s product. This isn't a traditional field engineering, solutions architecture, or professional services role. As a Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll work closely with customers while maintaining the technical standards and contribution discipline of a Staff-level product engineer.</p> <p>You'll work where strategic customer urgency, complex technical ambiguity, and GitLab product execution intersect. You'll partner directly with strategic customers and teams across Product, Engineering, Support, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Solutions Architecture (SA), Customer Success Architecture (CSA), Customer Success Management (CSM), and Professional Services. You'll diagnose and resolve high-impact adoption blockers, contribute production-quality fixes and features, and turn what you learn into repeatable patterns for GitLab and its customers.</p> <h2><strong>Why this role exists</strong></h2> <p>Strategic customers sometimes encounter challenges that are too broad, deep, urgent, or cross-functional for any single team to own from start to finish. These challenges may involve product gaps, performance degradation, scale bottlenecks, AI governance, adoption blockers, architectural constraints, Git usage patterns, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) complexity, application programming interface (API) automation, security requirements, or operational instability.</p> <p>Forward Deployed Engineering provides technical stewardship in these moments. The team doesn't simply observe, report, or escalate. You'll engage directly, diagnose the underlying technical problem, collaborate with the right teams, contribute code or technical solutions where appropriate, and transition the outcome into normal ownership once the customer is stable and the learning can be reused.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <h3><strong>Product contribution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Contribute production-quality code to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.</li> <li>Develop bug fixes, features, integrations, tooling, and performance improvements when strategic customer outcomes require direct engineering work.</li> <li>Work within GitLab’s product and engineering processes, including issue discovery, merge request creation, testing, review, documentation, and maintainability.</li> <li>Partner with Product and Engineering so customer-driven solutions support long-term product direction rather than becoming one-off customizations.</li> <li>Turn blockers discovered in the field into durable product improvements, reference architectures, documentation, and repeatable implementation patterns.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Strategic technical stewardship</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Engage with strategically important customers when adoption, retention, executive confidence, or public trust is materially at risk.</li> <li>Diagnose complex problems across GitLab product behavior, customer architecture, Git internals, CI/CD workflows, API usage, observability, infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments.</li> <li>Coordinate across Product, Engineering, SRE, Support, SA, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and customer technical teams to drive resolution from discovery through handoff.</li> <li>Provide recommendations grounded in data, traces, and systems analysis to improve GitLab usage, workflows, automation, and architecture.</li> <li>Create durable outcomes without establishing permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>AI adoption and agentic software development lifecycle</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Drive governed, measurable, and production-oriented adoption of GitLab Duo Agent Platform with strategic customers.</li> <li>Identify and resolve AI adoption blockers involving governance, usage controls, auditability, security, compliance, operating models, workflow design, and integrations.</li> <li>Develop customer-safe adoption patterns for the agentic software development lifecycle (SDLC), AI-assisted development, intent-based review, AI governance, and human-in-the-loop software delivery.</li> <li>Partner with Product, Engineering, Field, and Customer Success teams to turn AI adoption learning into reusable guidance and product improvements.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Thought leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Create technical narratives grounded in customer experience and product reality that can help shape the industry’s approach.</li> <li>Contribute to Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, reference architectures, technical strategy memos, and adoption frameworks.</li> <li>Guide ideas through discovery, formulation, validation, amplification, and adoption across GitLab.</li> <li>Partner with SA, CSA, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Product Marketing Management, CSM, Support, and executive stakeholders to make technical thought leadership a shared company capability.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Staff-level experience building, operating, or improving complex production software systems.</li> <li>Experience contributing to large, mature product codebases with high standards for testing, maintainability, performance, and security.</li> <li>Strong Ruby on Rails or Go experience and the ability to contribute directly to GitLab’s product and adjacent systems.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, AI governance, model evaluation, context management, prompt and workflow design, or AI adoption in enterprise environments.</li> <li>Experience diagnosing complex system behavior across application code, data stores, infrastructure, observability, networking, APIs, and customer usage patterns.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of modern DevSecOps workflows, including Git, merge requests, CI/CD, security controls, compliance needs, and enterprise software delivery.</li> <li>Experience working with strategic customers or senior technical stakeholders in ambiguous, high-impact situations.</li> <li>The ability to coordinate across product, engineering, field, and customer teams without formal authority.</li> <li>Strong written communication and sound judgment, including the ability to create technical narratives and distinguish reusable product work from customer-specific customization.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Strongly preferred qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Direct experience with GitLab as a platform, including GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, or GitLab Self-Managed.</li> <li>Production experience with Ruby on Rails, Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Sidekiq, Vue, TypeScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Linux, or observability tools.</li> <li>Deep familiarity with Git internals, repository performance, large-scale Git usage patterns, or GitLab Runner behavior.</li> <li>Experience creating technical thought-leadership materials, such as whitepapers, technical talks, architecture frameworks, requests for comments, public technical writing, or internal strategy documents.</li> <li>A background in performance engineering, site reliability engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, or distributed systems.</li> <li>Experience working in open source or highly asynchronous engineering environments.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Technologies and domains</strong></h2> <p>Directly relevant technologies and domains include:</p> <ul> <li>Ruby on Rails</li> <li>Go</li> <li>AI-assisted development and the agentic SDLC</li> <li>PostgreSQL</li> <li>Redis and Sidekiq</li> <li>Git internals</li> <li>GitLab CI/CD and Runner architecture</li> <li>Kubernetes and containers</li> <li>Terraform</li> <li>Linux, networking, observability, and performance analysis</li> <li>Vue and TypeScript</li> <li>APIs and automation</li> <li>DevSecOps governance, security, and compliance</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What this role is not</strong></h2> <p>This role isn't:</p> <ul> <li>A generic field engineering role.</li> <li>A proof-of-concept factory.</li> <li>A replacement for Solutions Architecture, Customer Success Architecture, Customer Success Management, Professional Services, Support, SRE, Product, or Engineering.</li> <li>A customer-specific customization function.</li> <li>Unbilled Professional Services.</li> <li>A requirements-gathering role that only escalates to Product.</li> <li>An AI evangelism role disconnected from product execution.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Success measures</strong></h2> <p>Success in this role may include:</p> <ul> <li>Stabilizing strategic customer adoption or retention risks.</li> <li>Fixing product bugs or contributing features.</li> <li>Removing AI adoption blockers for strategic accounts.</li> <li>Creating reusable implementation patterns and transitioning them to long-term owners.</li> <li>Producing or enabling Well-Architected Frameworks, whitepapers, webinars, or technical narratives.</li> <li>Resolving cross-functional customer challenges without creating permanent dependency on Forward Deployed Engineering.</li> <li>Equipping Product, Engineering, Support, CSA, CSM, Professional Services, and SA teams with better guidance based on learning from the field.</li> <li>Increasing adoption and effective use of GitLab capabilities, especially GitLab Duo and GitLab Duo Agent Platform, in targeted accounts.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>The Forward Deployed Engineering team connects strategic customer needs with GitLab product execution. The team works directly with customers and across GitLab to resolve complex adoption challenges, contribute durable product improvements, and create reusable technical guidance. Its goal is to stabilize urgent situations, improve the product, and transition ongoing ownership to the appropriate team rather than create a permanent dependency.</p> <h2><strong>Ideal candidate profile</strong></h2> <p>You're a Staff-level product or platform engineer who can operate in the field without becoming field-only. You're comfortable reading traces, writing production code, debugging architecture, discussing AI governance, leading a customer technical session, opening a merge request, outlining a whitepaper, and coordinating across teams to achieve a strategic customer outcome.</p> <p>You're not simply a strong communicator with technical awareness. You're a credible engineer with the judgment, presence, and narrative ability to turn customer reality into product contributions, adoption guidance, and company-level thought leadership.</p> <p>We welcome candidates with different backgrounds and levels of experience. Many successful candidates don't meet every qualification. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply and let our recruiting team assess your application.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees</strong></h4> <ul> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/">Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/time-off-and-absence/time-off-types/#flexible-paid-time-off-pto">Flexible Paid Time Off&nbsp;</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/company/culture/inclusion/tmrg-tmag/">Team Member Resource Groups</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/stock-options/">Equity Compensation &amp; Employee Stock Purchase Plan</a></li> <li><a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/people-group/learning-and-development/growth-and-development/">Growth and Development Fund</a></li> <li><a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/total-rewards/benefits/general-and-entity-benefits/#parental-leave">Parental Leave</a>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from <a href="https://about.gitlab.com/company/culture/inclusion/#examples-of-select-underrepresented-groups">underrepresented groups</a> are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Country Hiring Guidelines: </strong>GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Privacy Policy: </strong>Please review our <a href="https://handbook.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/candidate-faq/recruitment-privacy-policy/" target="_blank">Recruitment Privacy Policy.</a> Your privacy is important to us.</p> <p>GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#equal-employment-opportunity-policy" target="_blank">GitLab’s EEO Policy</a>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/labor-and-employment-notices/#eeoc-us-equal-employment-opportunity-commission-notices" target="_blank">EEO is the Law</a>. If you have a disability or special need that requires&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/people-policies/inc-usa/#reasonable-accommodation" target="_blank">accommodation</a>, please let us know during the&nbsp;<a href="https://about.gitlab.com/handbook/hiring/interviewing/#adjustments-to-our-interview-process" target="_blank">recruiting process</a>.</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering
description: <h2><strong>About Parloa</strong></h2> <p>Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.</p> <h2><strong>About the role:</strong></h2> <p>As a <strong>Manager, Forward Deployed Engineering </strong>at Parloa, you’ll be on the front lines of enterprise AI adoption — leading a high-impact team of FDEs that delivers our most strategic enterprise deployments. Your mission is to ensure our consistent deployment excellence: predictable delivery, strong engineering quality, and fast unblocking in complex enterprise environments — while staying technically credible yourself.</p> <p>FDEs are our in-field engineers. They build what doesn’t exist yet, adapt architecture to enterprise realities, and engineer integrations across systems and APIs to make deployments successful. As a Manager, you make that work repeatable and reliable across multiple customer projects — through strong delivery leadership, clear priorities, and hands-on technical guidance.</p> <h2><strong>Areas of ownership:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Lead and develop the team:</strong> hire, coach, and grow a team of FDEs; set clear expectations; run 1:1s, feedback cycles, and performance development.</li> <li><strong>Own capacity planning and staffing:</strong> allocate engineers across parallel strategic projects, manage load and utilization, and anticipate delivery bottlenecks early.</li> <li><strong>Drive project delivery management:</strong> own engineering delivery across deployments — milestones, dependencies, risk management, escalation paths, and stakeholder alignment.</li> <li><strong>Establish time tracking and delivery visibility:</strong> implement lightweight tracking and reporting that creates trusted insight into effort, progress, and capacity (without bureaucracy).</li> <li><strong>Provide technical leadership and escalation support:</strong> guide architecture and implementation choices, review designs/code when needed, and unblock high-severity issues in production environments.</li> <li><strong>Create scalable field engineering practices:</strong> build reusable patterns, playbooks, and standards that improve reliability, maintainability, and speed across deployments.</li> <li><strong>Shape the product via field learnings: </strong>translate recurring customer needs into clear productization proposals and partner with Product/Core Engineering to reduce one-offs over time.</li> <li><strong>Partner with customer engineering and enterprise stakeholders:</strong> collaborate directly with customer teams (architecture, security, platform) to deliver outcomes and build long-term technical trust.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our Tech Stack:&nbsp;</strong></h3> <p>Typescript, NodeJS, OpenAI, Microsoft Azure, Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, MongoDB, MySQL, Redis, Kafka, MCP</p> <h2><strong>Who you are:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience level:</strong> 8+ years in software engineering, systems integration, DevOps, or data engineering roles with meaningful production responsibility.</li> <li><strong>People leadership:</strong> proven ability to lead and develop engineers (e.g., formal management, team lead responsibility, coaching, hiring, performance growth).</li> <li><strong>Enterprise delivery track record:</strong> demonstrated success delivering complex technical projects in large enterprise environments with multiple stakeholders and constraints.</li> <li><strong>Technical breadth and depth:</strong> strong capabilities across backend engineering, APIs, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, infrastructure-as-code, and databases — able to review designs and guide production decisions.</li> <li><strong>Hands-on effectiveness:</strong> able to personally own and drive smaller technical workstreams end-to-end and to jump into debugging/implementation when necessary.</li> <li><strong>Operational excellence:</strong> strong planning, prioritization, capacity thinking, and risk management; creates delivery clarity without unnecessary process overhead.</li> <li><strong>Customer-facing communication:</strong> confident and credible with customer engineering teams and senior technical stakeholders; clear written and verbal communication.</li> <li><strong>Strong plus: experience building or integrating AI/LLM-powered systems (agent workflows, orchestration, evaluation, vector DBs, guardrails), ideally in forward-deployed or solutions engineering environments.</strong></li> </ul> <h2><strong>Our Recruiting Process:</strong></h2> <div> <p>Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser<br><br></p> <h2><strong>Why Parloa?</strong></h2> <p>We’re at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn’t just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We’re building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren’t just support tickets; they’re defining experiences. We’re here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.</p> <p>At Parloa, ownership isn’t a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that’s evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.</p> <p>We’ve grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we’ve kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.</p> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><iframe style="display: table; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;" src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/P4d-iyx7RQM" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <hr> <p>Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data.
